metadata.question: Does the total number of lakes in northern Siberia east of the Taz River decrease in 2002 compared to 1973?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need to define "northern Siberia east of the Taz River" - this is a large region in Russia - Taz River is located around 67-70°N, 78-80°E - Need historical data: 1973 vs 2002 - For lake detection: Landsat MSS for 1973, Landsat 7 for 2002 - Use water indices (NDWI or MNDWI) to detect water bodies 2. Masking strategy: - Mask clouds for both years - Use water index threshold to identify lakes - Count distinct water bodies/pixels 3. Logic: - Valid Zero: If lake count decreases (even to 0), that's a valid answer (A: Yes) - C1: No images available for either year - C2: After cloud masking, no valid pixels - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN - Compare total water pixels/area between years as proxy for lake count ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define region: Northern Siberia east of Taz River // Taz River approximately at 78-80°E, 67-70°N // Region east of this, up to ~180°E const region = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[80, 66], [80, 75], [180, 75], [180, 66], [80, 66]] ]); // 1973 - Landsat MSS (summer months for ice-free conditions) const col1973 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LM01/C02/T1') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate('1973-06-01', '1973-09-30') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); const count1973 = col1973.size().getInfo(); console.log(`1973 Images found: ${count1973}`); if (count1973 === 0) { // Try Landsat 2 MSS const col1973_l2 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LM02/C02/T1') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate('1973-06-01', '1973-09-30') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); const count1973_l2 = col1973_l2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`1973 Landsat 2 Images: ${count1973_l2}`); if (count1973_l2 === 0) { console.log('No 1973 data available'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 2002 - Landsat 7 const col2002 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate('2002-06-01', '2002-09-30') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); const count2002 = col2002.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2002 Images found: ${count2002}`); if (count2002 === 0) { console.log('No 2002 data available'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Process 1973 - Use Green and NIR for water detection const img1973 = col1973.median(); // For MSS: Band 4 is NIR, Band 5 is Red (approximation) const water1973 = img1973.normalizedDifference(['SR_B1', 'SR_B2']).gt(0.1); const waterStats1973 = water1973.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const waterPixels1973 = waterStats1973.get('SR_B1').getInfo(); if (waterPixels1973 === null || waterPixels1973 === undefined) { console.log('1973 calculation failed'); console.log('C3'); return; } console.log(`1973 Water pixels: ${waterPixels1973}`); // Process 2002 const img2002 = col2002.median(); // MNDWI for Landsat 7: (Green - SWIR1) / (Green + SWIR1) const water2002 = img2002.normalizedDifference(['SR_B2', 'SR_B5']).gt(0.1); const waterStats2002 = water2002.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const waterPixels2002 = waterStats2002.get('SR_B2').getInfo(); if (waterPixels2002 === null || waterPixels2002 === undefined) { console.log('2002 calculation failed'); console.log('C3'); return; } console.log(`2002 Water pixels: ${waterPixels2002}`); if (waterPixels1973 === 0 && waterPixels2002 === 0) { console.log('No valid water pixels detected'); console.log('C2'); return; } // Compare water extent as proxy for lake count const decreased = waterPixels2002 < waterPixels1973; const changePercent = ((waterPixels2002 - waterPixels1973) / waterPixels1973 * 100).toFixed(1); console.log(`Change: ${changePercent}%`); if (decreased) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
